risk_note: RV2 (migration 0055, invite reward storage; amounts in integer fen). app.invite_rewards keeps one qualification row per invitee (unique app_id + invitee_id) with per-side results and skip / void reason codes matching the CT-25a enums (a skip reason only with result skipped, NULL-safe), bind_ip_hmac, the triggering order referencing order_keys, row_version; no DELETE / TRUNCATE grant. app.invite_reward_budgets holds one row per app and period ('total' or a date) with reserved_fen and granted_fen (date rows keep reserved at 0), limits read from config, decremented by conditional updates (shape agreed in orchestrator ruling D10-94 3). One GRANT per table and role. schema.sql and db.gen.ts regenerated on the test machine; only the two new tables change. Renumbered from 0056 to 0055 because migration numbers must be contiguous. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
